itemListElement.name: Granola AI Alternatives That Work for US Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Granola AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk is the best all-round alternative if you want bot-free capture plus prep, live answers and follow-up tasks. Jamie is the closest bot-free match, and Fathom is best if you want free video recording.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Granola alternative for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Granola itself now runs on Windows for video calls. If you want an alternative, Fathom, Fireflies and Otter work through a meeting bot on any operating system, and Lynkk works from any desktop browser.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Granola alternative for Android?

acceptedAnswer.text: Granola launched an Android app on 1 July 2026 for in-person conversations. Otter and Jamie also offer mobile capture if you want a different tool.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source alternative to Granola?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Meetily is an open-source, local meeting note tool that keeps audio on your machine. It needs more setup and has fewer integrations than Granola.
Granola has a free Basic plan with AI notes, but it keeps only 30 days of meeting history. Business costs $14 per user per month and removes that limit. See our Granola pricing guide.

mainEntity.name: Which Granola alternative creates Jira tickets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lynkk sends action items from meetings to Jira in one click, with owners and dates attached.
